origin: Raw files written by ngspice 47 (Windows build) for netlists authored in this repository (M7 T1)
author: xdylanm
notes: Samples for the clean-room raw-file reader in tests/support/ngspice.py. Each X.raw is `ngspice_con -b -r X.raw -o X.log X.cir` for the X.cir beside it: op (one real point), ac (complex values, three frequencies), tran (61 real points) and two (.op and .ac in one file: two plots, the AC plot written first). ngspice 47 writes CRLF line endings in raw files, with or without SPICE_ASCIIRAWFILE.
